text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. I visited 
Nakayama Racecourse together with Royce 
and Royce to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nice, got the best spot♪ Now then, how's 
everyone looking—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san is so formidable...! With 
consistent results, she even won the prep 
race. We can expect a great run from her 
today, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san is... hehe, as energetic as 
ever today. I'm just a little worried she 
might pull too hard.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Taishin-san, that looks great...! How 
should I put it, the vibe is totally 
different.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Will it come down to a battle between 
these three after all...? Now then, let us 
witness the Satsuki Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume are passing the third 
corner. Who will emerge victorious in the 
Satsuki Sho?!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The home stretch is short here! Which 
means—I have to make my move early!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Ticket. But I already 
factored in your late sweep!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah! Yaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san and the others made their 
move! What about Taishin-san—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still in the back! Surely, with this kind 
of gap—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Biwa Hayahide, coming up 
the hill! Can Winning Ticket not find any 
extra gear?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "From here on! Haaah!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin 
surges from the outside in one fell swoop!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: She's fast!! No way, it can't be—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll overtake you all at once! Daaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin surges past them! The 
winner is Narita Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I pushed past them...! Past the likes of 
Hayahide-san!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin roared right up from behind! Even 
though she was in second to last!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
On Nakayama's short straight, sweeping up 
all at once from the back... What an 
incredible late charge!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"She's on a whole... different level... To 
think she was... this incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was overwhelming... just like 
Teio-san's Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
People say being on the outside puts you 
at a disadvantage, or that you lose 
distance, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That has nothing to do with me!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin-san and the others are... just 
like Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With that run, an unforgettable impression 
can be etched into their minds.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The roar of this crowd says it all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"With that kind of explosive power, the 
Derby's totally within reach! A fierce 
charge from behind! What a thrilling win!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She charged up that hill in one breath! If 
she can do that on a tough track like 
Nakayama, our hopes are sky-high!

The crowd's excitement has yet to cool 
down. Narita Taishin's closing burst 
showed both high potential and great 
promise for the Classic campaign ahead.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...With my running style, it wouldn't have 
gone like this. I'm glad I didn't enter 
the race...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Our choice should have been the 
right one—
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure we can look back and say 
it was the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer-san... Yes... yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin-san's impact was even greater 
than expected, though."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Then I just have to leave an impression 
that outshines it! Through self-producing!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's blow them away with round two!
Yeah! Let's make the second one a blast!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce, how are you feeling right 
now heading into your goal, the Japan 
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Since we skipped the Satsuki 
Sho, I've made thorough preparations.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean by thorough preparation? 
If you don't mind, please tell me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
From the Aoba Sho to the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby)— winning these two races 
is my goal!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, winning both of those races...! 
No one has ever achieved it, and it is 
said to be exceedingly difficult—
choice_data_list:
Of course, we've prepared for this 
rotation as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
! I see...! So your preparations are 
flawless! I'm expecting great things!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. First off, I will 
definitely take 1st place in the Aoba Sho!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What incredible confidence...! Could this 
actually turn out to be something 
amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, looks like we're drawing attention, 
mainly from reporters and race fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've talked such a big game, 
you need to deliver a performance at the 
Aoba Sho that proves you can overcome that 
tough rotation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The problem is what comes after. Just how 
much the toll from running the Aoba Sho 
will affect the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
However, we can't be naive enough to think 
we can win while holding back. If that's 
the case, stamina recovery is paramount.

A training plan to enhance recovery 
capacity has already been drawn up, but 
whether that alone will suffice remains to 
be seen until we put it into action.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First, focused on the Aoba Sho right in 
front of me. I'll boost my recovery and 
take the win!
